items.title: TRACE 与 ECHO:turn 级信用分配的两条可复现路线(BrowseComp-Plus 大幅增益)
items.innovation: TRACE(arXiv 2607.13988):以工具调用边界为状态转移,用冻结参考模型对标准答案的 log-prob 作状态价值,每轮奖励=该价值的 TD 变化——无 critic、无过程标注,冗余调用自动被伸缩抵消;ECHO(arXiv 2606.31650):每轮压缩为带来源索引的记忆记录,同一索引既重建策略上下文(prune to act)又把结果奖励只路由到支撑答案的轮次(trace to learn)
items.analysis: Performance(均作者自报):TRACE 纯 RL 无 SFT 冷启动,Qwen3-4B 7.2→35.6、Qwen3-30B-A3B 8.4→42.6;ECHO 留出集 43.4% 对 GRPO 28.9%、滚动摘要 SUPO 36.1%,且轮数更少。判断:长程 agent RL 最可复现的进展在 turn 级信用分配而非新算法族;与工业披露呼应——GLM-5.2 因轨迹级优势模糊而重回 critic PPO,K3 的瓶颈在 partial rollout 与可恢复沙箱等系统层。对 RL-on-NPU 意义:两法均不依赖额外 critic 模型的前向/反向,显存画像友好;ECHO 的记忆索引与 SAO compaction(D34)同为'上下文管理进入训练分布'的实例。

items.title: 记忆增强 RL 谱系:从 MemAgent 到 Memory-R2 的 LoGo-GRPO 与 HiMPO
items.org: 字节 Seed/清华;LMU/华为/TUM 等
items.innovation: 让 agent 通过 RL 学会读写记忆:MemAgent(定长记忆逐块覆写,32K 训练泛化到 3.5M token QA);Mem-α(核心/情景/语义记忆工具,30K 训练泛化到 400K+);Memory-R2(arXiv 2605.21768)指出记忆使过去动作成为未来环境的一部分、轨迹级组内比较失效,提出 LoGo-GRPO=全局轨迹奖励+从同一中间记忆状态局部重采样;HiMPO(arXiv 2606.16285)以写入前后可恢复信息量为记忆写入定信用
items.analysis: Innovation:问题被逐步形式化——记忆操作的信用分配是普通 GRPO 的盲区(组内轨迹起点不同),Memory-R2 的局部重采样与 HiMPO 的信息增益奖励是两种修正;Mem-T 的训练免费变体已达 LoCoMo 50.08 F1 超 Memory-R1/MemAgent。判断:数字均为作者自报、基座多在 4B-8B;但方向明确——记忆不再是外挂检索,而是策略的一部分并由 RL 塑形。对 RL-on-NPU 意义:记忆式 RL 用短窗口训练换长上下文泛化(32K→3.5M),对显存受限加速器是最直接的长程路线;LoGo-GRPO 的局部重采样增加 rollout 分叉,与 D26 前缀缓存/KV 复用主线相接。

items.title: JitRL 与 aTTT:部署期在线适应的两条路(训练免费 logit 修正 vs 回合内权重更新)
items.innovation: JitRL(arXiv 2601.18510):非参数轨迹记忆检索相似状态、即时估计逐动作优势并加到冻结模型 logits——证明为 KL 约束策略优化的闭式解,无梯度更新;aTTT(arXiv 2607.03441):多轮回合内持续在自身轨迹上更新权重,以 token 级重加权抑制自训练重复漂移
items.analysis: Performance(自报):JitRL WebArena 51.4% 对训练免费基线 ≤44%,WebArena-Lite 同基座超 WebRL 且计算 <3%;aTTT ALFWorld +5.0、SWE-bench Lite +4.9。判断:训练免费路线已接近可用,回合内权重 TTT 增益有限且需对抗漂移;TTT-E2E(2M 长度匹配全注意力且快 35×)属长上下文压缩而非跨会话知识积累。对 RL-on-NPU 意义:JitRL 把'适应'变成推理时的检索+加性偏置,零训练基建即可在 NPU 推理集群上部署,是国产栈上最低门槛的持续学习入口;权重级在线更新仍无前沿实验室机制披露。

items.title: Rubric/生成式奖励 RL(RaR 入 ICLR 2026,universal verifier 进旗舰管线)
items.org: Scale AI 系 / OpenAI / 学界
items.innovation: 把 RLVR 的成功范式外推到主观域:Rubrics as Rewards(arXiv 2507.17746,ICLR 2026)以结构化 rubric 替代可验证信号;OpenAI 'universal verifier'(LLM 评审 LLM)被报道用于 GPT-5 训练,覆盖商业决策/创意写作等域
items.analysis: Innovation:2026 年密集跟进——QUBRIC(查询-rubric 协同设计)、EvoRubric(自进化 rubric)、Open Rubric System(成对自适应 rubric 规模化);与自进化 agent 方向交叉(自生成验证替代人工标注)。判断:RLVR 之后最确定的路线,但 reward hacking 未解、'universal'含营销成分;rubric 评分器同时出现在训练(奖励)与产品(Anthropic Outcomes)两侧,评估器成为方案组件。对 RL-on-NPU 意义:生成式奖励把奖励计算变成推理负载,rollout 与奖励可同栈部署——对推理强的 NPU 集群是利好;奖励模型的训推一致(与被训模型共享量化方案)是延伸问题。详见 Dispatch 35。

items.title: 超长程信用分配综述(真实 agent 已达 100K-1M token,方法只验证到 5-30 轮)
items.innovation: 综述《From Reasoning to Agentic: Credit Assignment in RL for LLMs》(arXiv 2604.09459)指出核心断层:部署中的 agent 轨迹已达 100K-1M token、100+ 轮交互,而现有信用分配方法多只在 5-30 轮任务上验证
items.analysis: Innovation:2026 年方法带包括 TRACE、Hindsight Credit Assignment、SOLAR-RL、ECHO(选择性轮次记忆)等;工业样本出现(双时限信用分配)。判断:多天任务的产品曲线(METR 16h+)真实且陡峭,但'多天任务怎么训'的方法论明显落后于部署现实——这是 D23 三难题中信用分配轴的最新量化表述,也是学术切入的高价值缺口。对 RL-on-NPU 意义:超长轨迹的 RL 训练受显存与序列并行约束最紧,与 D26 推理效率、D34 SAO compaction(压缩片段训练)是同一约束的不同解法。

items.title: WM-R1:世界模型替代真实环境做 GUI agent RL rollout
items.innovation: 用学习到的世界模型完全替代真实 Android 环境执行 RL rollout(arXiv 2608.27508),把环境交互成本从真实沙箱迁移到神经模拟器;同线工作含 MobileDreamer 与 MobileWorldBench(140 万三元组)
items.analysis: Innovation:直击 agent RL 的环境交互成本瓶颈,与环境采购市场构成'买环境还是学环境'的路线对照。反向证据并存:agent 尚不能把世界模型当预见工具使用(arXiv 2601.03905),泛化到终端/浏览器环境未证明。对 RL-on-NPU 意义:世界模型 rollout 把环境交互变成纯推理负载——恰是 NPU 强项,若路线成立,昇腾集群可在不依赖 x86 沙箱基建的情况下自闭环 GUI agent RL;这为 D02 rollout 瓶颈增加第四条解法轴(算法/调度/数值之外)。

items.title: OLMo 3 / OlmoRL(model flow 全开放的 RLVR 训练主干)
items.innovation: RLVR 从 Tülu 3 的收尾工序升级为训练主干:OlmoRL 工程包(active sampling、token 级损失归一化、无 KL、clip-higher、截断 IS、异步 in-flight 权重更新)全部开源;RL Zero 从 base 直训+激进去污染+随机奖励负对照
items.analysis: Innovation:完整 model flow 开放——Dolma 3(9.3T 池)、Dolci 后训练数据、OLMo-core/open-instruct 代码、预训练每 1000 步 checkpoint、公开 WandB 曲线,Openness Index 89 分居首;Delta Learning DPO 以 chosen(Qwen3-32B)与 rejected(0.6B)的质量差为信号。Performance:1024 张 H100 上异步 RL 提速约 4×,32B Think 的 RL 从 15 天以上压至约 6 天;Think 32B 以约 1/6 训练 token 逼近 Qwen 3 32B(二手转述,provisional);7B RL 复现约 32-72 卡可及。对 RL-on-NPU 意义:效率感知 RL 等消融研究的更干净基座(数据可审计,RL Zero 负对照排除泄漏混杂);OlmoRL 组件是 MindSpeed-RL 语境最可借鉴的公开实现;open-instruct/OLMo-core 的昇腾移植为空白。详见 Dispatch 31。

items.title: slime v0.3.1(训推一致内建化:top-p masking + R3 路由专家)
items.innovation: top-p masking 让训练侧复现 rollout 的有效采样分布,训推一致从外挂探针变成框架内建能力
items.analysis: Innovation: 08-06 发布的 v0.3.1 把训推一致做进框架:top-p masking 使训练侧 logprob 计算复现 rollout 时的有效采样分布,配合 PD 分离 + R3 路由专家(记录并回放 MoE 路由,与 Miles 的 R3 同源思路)从源头压制 MoE RL 的训推失配;另有并行 update_from_disk 权重更新、融合 PPO logprob/entropy 算子,并移除了 Megatron Bridge 依赖。Performance: 官方 release note 口径,GLM 系生产 RL 栈的例行大版本。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 训推一致正是 Ascend 上数值漂移(本看板 align-probe 主线)最敏感的环节——top-p masking 与 R3 都是纯算法/记录层手段,不依赖 CUDA 特性,是最值得优先移植到 NPU 训练栈的一致性机制;去 Megatron Bridge 也缩小了向 MindSpeed 侧适配的接口面。
items.summary: slime v0.3.1(08-06):top-p masking 在训练侧复现 rollout 有效采样分布(训推一致内建化)、并行 update_from_disk 权重更新、PD 分离 + R3 路由专家、融合 PPO logprob/entropy 算子,并移除 Megatron Bridge。

items.title: ESTR(熵缩放信任域:异步 off-policy 追平同步 GRPO)
items.innovation: 发现 off-policy 偏差随 token 熵内生缩放,据此构造熵缩放信任域
items.analysis: Innovation: 指出异步 RL 的 off-policy 偏差并非均匀分布,而是随 token 熵内生缩放——高熵 token 承担更大的分布漂移;据此把信任域(clip 范围)按熵缩放,给高熵 token 更宽容忍度、低熵 token 更紧约束。Performance: BrowseComp-Plus 37.3,超异步基线 34.9,并追平同步 GRPO——异步吞吐不再以牺牲最终性能为代价。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 异步/训推分离是 Ascend 上绕开 sleep-mode 缺失的主路线,而 staleness 容忍度一直是瓶颈;ESTR 与 Staleness–LR 标度律、GAC 同属'让高异步度可用'的稳定器,且只改 loss 端 clip 逻辑,NPU 移植成本几乎为零。
items.summary: 熵缩放信任域:利用 off-policy 偏差随 token 熵内生缩放的规律自适应调整 clip 范围,BrowseComp-Plus 37.3 vs 异步基线 34.9,追平同步 GRPO。

items.title: PNPO(因果前缀几何平均比率,rollout 安全复用多 epoch)
items.innovation: 把重要性比率改为因果前缀几何平均,使同一批 rollout 可安全复用多个 epoch
items.analysis: Innovation: 针对 rollout 复用多 epoch 时重要性比率方差爆炸的问题,把 token 级/序列级比率改为因果前缀几何平均——每个 token 的比率由其因果前缀的几何平均平滑,兼得 token 级信用分配与序列级稳定性。Performance: 4 epoch 复用下超 GSPO 3.00 分,说明在高复用(强 off-policy)区间优势更明显。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: rollout 是 NPU RL 最贵的环节(>70% 墙钟、显存大头),同一批 rollout 能安全多 epoch 复用直接把生成成本摊薄数倍——与 Train Less Learn More 的自适应采样、ExGRPO 的经验回放同向,是 Ascend 上'少生成、多利用'路线的算法端支点。
items.summary: 把重要性比率改为因果前缀几何平均,使 rollout 可安全复用多个 epoch:4 epoch 下超 GSPO 3.00 分,直接摊薄 RL 中最贵的生成成本。

items.title: RLSVR / SpyRL(任务变换:把开放任务转成规则可验证自博弈)
items.innovation: 用「谁是卧底」式自博弈把摘要/创意写作等开放任务变换成规则可验证博弈
items.analysis: Innovation: RLVR 只覆盖可形式化验证的任务,RLSVR/SpyRL 提出'任务变换'——把开放式生成任务嵌进规则可判胜负的博弈(「谁是卧底」自博弈:生成质量由博弈胜负这一硬规则裁决),从而免 reward model 地为不可验证任务制造可验证奖励。Performance: 摘要/创意写作胜率 75.4%/77.3%,且反哺数学 +8.97%/+6.16%(COLM 2026)。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 与 Right in the Right Way 的判别器混合奖励同属'扩大 RLVR 疆域'路线,但奖励端只需规则判定、无需额外 RM 前向,显存与算子负担比判别器方案更轻——对 64GB 910B 上的开放任务 RL 是更省资源的配方。
items.summary: 任务变换把开放任务转成规则可验证博弈(「谁是卧底」自博弈):摘要/创意写作胜率 75.4%/77.3%,数学 +8.97%/+6.16%,免 reward model 扩大 RLVR 覆盖面(COLM 2026)。

items.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731(底座不变重做 RL 后训练,反超自家 Pro)
items.innovation: 同一底座仅重做 RL 后训练,Terminal-Bench 2.1 +25.8 分并反超 V4-Pro-Preview
items.analysis: Innovation: 07-31 发布的 V4-Flash 更新版底座完全不变、只重做 agentic RL 后训练配方,Terminal-Bench 2.1 从 56.9 跳到 82.7(+25.8)、DeepSWE 54.4,以 13B 激活反超参数量数倍的自家 V4-Pro-Preview。Performance: 这是'后训练配方 > 底座规模'迄今最直接的单变量证据——同底座对照消除了预训练混杂因素(数字为厂商自报,待第三方复验)。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 若后训练配方的杠杆确实大于底座规模,那么在算力受限的 Ascend 集群上把预算投给 RL 后训练迭代(而非更大底座)是性价比更高的路径;且 V4 系已在 vLLM-Ascend 支持,13B 激活的 Flash 是 910B 上现实可跑的 agentic RL 底座候选。
items.summary: 07-31 更新:底座不变仅重做 RL 后训练,Terminal-Bench 2.1 56.9→82.7(+25.8)、DeepSWE 54.4,反超自家 V4-Pro-Preview——「后训练配方>底座规模」最直接的同底座对照证据(厂商自报)。

items.title: AReaL v2.0.0(微服务化重构的异步 RL 训练系统)
items.innovation: 训练/推理/agent/权重更新拆成四个独立微服务,areal CLI 统一编排
items.analysis: Innovation: 把原本单体式的异步 RL 系统重构为训练、推理、agent、权重更新四个独立微服务,统一由 areal CLI 管理;新增基于 agent service 的端到端 agent 训练(Hermes + OpenClaw 示例)、CISPO loss(MiniMax-M1 同款)、Qwen3.5/3.6 MoE 训推支持、colocate 场景 CUDA IPC 权重传输、RolloutEngine 上的 on-policy 蒸馏。Performance: 20 位贡献者参与(11 位为新社区成员),社区化程度明显上升。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: AReaL 有专门 ascend 分支,2.0 把权重更新独立成服务后,替换为 HCCL 传输后端(vLLM-Ascend v0.22.1rc1 已提供)即可打通 Ascend 上的异步训推流水线——这次架构重构直接决定后续 NPU 后端接入的形态。
items.summary: AReaL 2.0 大版本:微服务化架构(训练/推理/agent/权重更新四服务)+ areal CLI 统一管理,新增端到端 agent 训练、CISPO loss、Qwen3.5/3.6 MoE 训推、CUDA IPC 权重传输与 on-policy 蒸馏。

items.title: Staleness–LR Scaling Law(异步 RLHF 的陈旧度-学习率联合标度律)
items.org: arXiv 预印本(Chuan Wu、Linfeng Zhang、Weixun Wang 等)
items.innovation: 证明陈旧 rollout 带来 O(S·η) 每步梯度偏差,导出 staleness-学习率联合缩放律
items.analysis: Innovation: 针对训推解耦的高吞吐异步 RLHF,把 behavior policy 显式写进 GRPO surrogate 目标,区分 learner 使用的 surrogate 梯度与真实总导数,证明陈旧 rollout 造成 O(S·η) 量级的每步梯度偏差(S 为最大 rollout 滞后步数,η 为学习率)。Performance: 由此导出可操作的联合缩放律——异步度越高,学习率应按比例缩小。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 异步/解耦是 Ascend 上绕开 sleep-mode 缺失的主要路线(AReaL/AsyncFlow),但 staleness 一直靠经验调参;这是首个定量指导 NPU 集群异步训练超参与滞后步数取舍的标度律,与 GAC、Stable Asynchrony 等稳定器互补。
items.summary: 首个'staleness–学习率'联合缩放律:把 behavior policy 显式写进 GRPO surrogate,证明陈旧 rollout 带来 O(S·η) 每步梯度偏差,异步度越高学习率应按比例缩小。

items.title: Right in the Right Way(可验证奖励 + 人类示范判别器的混合奖励)
items.innovation: 对抗式判别器从人类示范学 learned reward,补足 RLVR 不可形式化维度
items.analysis: Innovation: 提出 generator–discriminator 对抗框架,用区分人写与模型生成输出的判别器信号作为 learned reward,与可验证奖励组合,覆盖 RLVR 只优化可打分指标的盲区。Performance: bug 修复任务上保持 RLVR 同等准确率的同时显著降低补丁编辑距离,故事生成上提升胜率与多样性,并在 reward hacking 基准上几乎消除作弊行为。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: RLVR 之后奖励设计的代表性新配方——'可验证 + 学习型人类分布'混合奖励对 RL 后训练算法选型有直接参考价值,且判别器是标准分类模型,移植到 NPU 训练栈的成本低。
items.summary: 对抗式 generator–discriminator 混合奖励:判别器从人类示范学到不可形式化维度的 learned reward,与 RLVR 组合,在保持准确率的同时降低补丁编辑距离并几乎消除 reward hacking。

items.title: TRL v1.7.0/1.7.1(AsyncGRPO 改进 + 非 NVLink 硬件修复)
items.innovation: chunked_nll 默认 loss 降显存 ~30% + AsyncGRPO + 非 NVLink colocate 修复
items.analysis: Innovation: v1.7.0 把 SFT 默认 loss 换成 chunked_nll(平均峰值显存约降 30%),新增 MoE 辅助损失、实验性 GMPO trainer、transformers 连续批处理集成与 AsyncGRPO 改进;v1.7.1 修复 GRPO + vLLM colocate + PEFT 在非 NVLink 硬件上的挂起问题。Performance: 显存降幅与 async 吞吐为官方 release note 口径。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 最大众化的 RL 库进入 async GRPO 路线,印证异步化已成默认方向;非 NVLink 互联下 colocate 挂起的修复对异构加速器(含 HCCS 互联的 Ascend)上跑 GRPO 有直接借鉴——TRL 本身也是 Ascend 上最易上手的 RL 入口(910B GRPO 已验证)。
items.summary: TRL v1.7.0 引入 chunked_nll 默认 loss(峰值显存约降 30%)、MoE 辅助损失、实验性 GMPO trainer 与 AsyncGRPO 改进;v1.7.1 修复非 NVLink 硬件上 GRPO + vLLM colocate + PEFT 挂起。

items.title: Miles (RadixArk RL framework: FP8 + R3)
items.innovation: End-to-end FP8 + Rollout Routing Replay for bit-exact MoE RL
items.analysis: Innovation: an enterprise RL post-training framework (SGLang rollout + Megatron training, forked from slime) with two standout pieces — a unified end-to-end FP8 sampling+training pipeline, and Rollout Routing Replay (R3): record MoE expert-routing during SGLang inference and replay it during Megatron training for bit-wise train/inference alignment, fixing the quantization/routing mismatch that collapses MoE RL. Plus INT4 QAT (1TB+ models), online-draft speculative decoding (~25% rollout speedup), zero-copy CUDA-IPC weight sync. Fit for RL-on-NPU: R3 is the GPU answer to exactly what align-probe wants to measure on Ascend — whether MoE routing + FP8 stay consistent across the NPU train/inference gap; porting R3 + unified FP8 to SGLang-Ascend + MindSpeed is a concrete, high-value gap.
items.summary: RadixArk's open RL framework for LLM/VLM post-training (from the SGLang team; built on slime). First end-to-end FP8 sampling+training, and Rollout Routing Replay (R3) for bit-exact MoE train-inference alignment. SGLang rollout + Megatron training. Supports DeepSeek/Qwen/Llama/GLM.

items.title: Agentic RL for LLMs (Landscape survey)
items.innovation: Maps agentic RL as a distinct POMDP paradigm vs single-step LLM RL
items.analysis: Innovation: the reference map of the field — frames agentic RL as temporally-extended POMDPs (vs the single-step MDP of vanilla RLVR), organizing methods by capability (planning, tool use, memory, reflection) and challenge. Fit for RL-on-NPU: the survey's emphasis on long multi-turn rollouts is exactly the regime that stresses Ascend's 64GB HBM + no-sleep-mode; good orientation before porting agentic RL to NPU.
items.summary: The Landscape of Agentic RL for LLMs — a 2025/26 survey reframing LLMs from passive generators into decision-making agents, with a taxonomy of capabilities (planning, tool use, memory, reflection) and open challenges.

items.title: Credit Assignment in RL for LLMs (survey)
items.innovation: Two-dimensional taxonomy of 47 credit-assignment methods
items.analysis: Innovation: surveys 47 credit-assignment (CA) methods (41 core + 6 enablers, 2024–early 2026) along granularity (token / segment / step / turn / multi-agent) × methodology (MC / TD / model-based / game-theoretic / info-theoretic). Fit for RL-on-NPU: CA is the central bottleneck of long-horizon agentic RL; the per-turn advantage math layered on NPU-rewritten ops compounds train-inference drift — what align-probe should watch.
items.summary: From Reasoning to Agentic: a survey of temporal credit assignment in LLM RL — episode-level reward is uninformative over 10–100+ turn trajectories, so CA granularity/method is the key design axis.

items.title: VerlTool (ARLT: agentic RL with tool use)
items.innovation: Unified tool-use agentic RL on verl with fully async rollouts
items.analysis: Innovation: extends verl to Agentic RL with Tool use (ARLT) — a unified tool interface + credit assignment across sequential tool calls, with fully asynchronous rollouts to avoid synchronous batch stalls. Fit for RL-on-NPU: async rollout is precisely the lever Ascend needs (no sleep-mode), and tool-use rollouts are long/memory-heavy — a strong target to port and pair with quantized rollout.
items.summary: A holistic ARLT framework on the verl codebase: standardizes multi-turn tool use, handles credit assignment across tool calls, and runs fully asynchronous rollouts for efficiency.

items.title: AgentRL (multi-turn, multi-task agentic RL)
items.innovation: Scales agentic RL across many turns and tasks in one system
items.summary: A multi-turn, multi-task RL framework for scaling agentic training — coordinates diverse environments/tasks so a single agent learns across them, addressing the systems cost of long agentic rollouts.

items.title: SkyRL-Agent (efficient multi-turn agent RL)
items.innovation: Training-efficiency techniques targeted at multi-turn agents
items.summary: Efficient RL training for multi-turn LLM agents — reduces the rollout/training cost that dominates agentic RL, complementing async frameworks like VerlTool/ProRL Agent.

items.title: Train Less, Learn More (adaptive rollout optimization)
items.innovation: Adaptively allocates rollout budget per group in GRPO-style RL
items.analysis: Innovation: an adaptive, efficient rollout scheme for group-based RL (GRPO) — spends more sampling budget on prompt-groups where extra rollouts actually move the gradient and fewer where they don't, plus response reuse. Fit for RL-on-NPU: rollout is >70% of RL wall-clock and the memory hog on Ascend; spending fewer/cheaper rollouts is a direct, framework-level lever against the no-sleep-mode contention (see Dispatch 02).
items.summary: Adaptive Efficient Rollout Optimization for group-based RL: allocates sampling budget per group and reuses responses to improve RLVR sample efficiency without hurting final reward.

items.title: Jet-RL (on-policy FP8 RL)
items.innovation: Unified train+rollout precision flow for on-policy FP8 RL
items.analysis: Innovation: unifies the precision of the trainer and the rollout engine so FP8 rollouts stay numerically consistent with the policy the trainer assumes — killing the train-inference mismatch that makes naive FP8 RL unstable. Fit for RL-on-NPU: this is the missing 'how' for FP8 RL, and Ascend 950's native FP8 makes the same recipe a high-novelty target on NPU; the consistency it enforces is exactly what align-probe should measure on Ascend.
items.summary: Enables on-policy FP8 RL by keeping training and rollout on a unified precision flow, so low-precision generation doesn't drift from the higher-precision policy — addressing FP8 RL's core instability.

items.title: Efficient RL with Quantized Rollout
items.innovation: Quantize only the rollout (INT8/FP8) for 20–80% throughput
items.analysis: Innovation: quantizes just the rollout/generation stage (INT8 or FP8) while keeping training precision, exploiting that rollout is inference. Performance: 20–80% throughput gains on 7B/14B/32B. Fit for RL-on-NPU: rollout is >70% of RL wall-clock and the memory hog on Ascend's no-sleep-mode HBM — a quantized rollout shrinks that footprint directly, the cheapest port of GPU rollout tricks to NPU.
items.summary: Quantizes the rollout phase (INT8/FP8) to accelerate RL generation, reporting 20–80% throughput improvements on 7B–32B models without quantizing the training step.

items.title: GAC (Gradient Alignment Control)
items.innovation: Aligns gradient directions to stabilize async RL
items.analysis: Innovation: controls/aligns the gradient directions produced under asynchrony so stale-sample updates don't fight the on-policy signal. Fit for RL-on-NPU: async decoupling of rollout vs train is the main lever for NPU throughput (no sleep-mode), but staleness destabilizes GRPO — GAC is one of the 2026 stabilizers that make high-asynchrony RL usable on Ascend.
items.summary: Stabilizes asynchronous RL training for LLMs via Gradient Alignment Control — keeping updates from stale rollouts aligned so high-asynchrony training stays stable.

items.title: ReSum (RLVR + self-summarization)
items.innovation: Compresses reasoning via self-summarization to avoid overlong rollouts
items.analysis: Innovation: an RLVR framework where the model learns to self-summarize its reasoning trajectory mid-rollout, compressing long chains so they don't blow the context budget while keeping coherence. Performance: targets the 'overlong rollout degrades reasoning + wastes context' failure mode of vanilla RLVR. Fit for RL-on-NPU: shorter/compressed rollouts directly cut KV-cache memory during generation — exactly the pressure that bites on 64GB 910B (see the RL 显存争用 view).
items.summary: An RLVR framework that lets an LLM compress its reasoning via mid-trajectory self-summarization, avoiding overlong rollouts that waste context and hurt coherence (submitted Jun 11 2026).

items.title: FP8-RL: stable low-precision RL stack
items.innovation: Practical, stable FP8 stack for LLM reinforcement learning
items.analysis: Innovation: a practical FP8 rollout (and partial training) stack for RL, tackling FP8's instability in the RL loop with engineering + algorithmic fixes. Performance: reports stable low-precision RL with memory/throughput wins (paper-reported). Fit for RL-on-NPU: this is the missing recipe for the 'FP8 RL on Ascend' opportunity the 950 series opens — and the precision pitfalls it documents are exactly what align-probe should watch for on NPU.
items.summary: A practical, stable FP8 stack for LLM RL — addresses the instability of applying FP8 in the rollout/training loop via engineering and algorithmic techniques. Directly relevant to FP8 RL on next-gen NPUs.

items.title: ROLL Flash (async RLVR + agentic)
items.innovation: Asynchronous RLVR/agentic training with fine-grained parallelism
items.summary: Extends ROLL with a fully asynchronous training workflow and fine-grained parallelism to accelerate RLVR and agentic post-training — another point in the async/disaggregated RL design space.

items.title: TR-GRPO (Token-Regulated GRPO)
items.innovation: Token-level regulation stabilizes GRPO training
items.summary: Regulates per-token contributions in the GRPO objective to stabilize RL for LLMs, reducing variance/instability in long-sequence updates.

items.title: From Player to Master (test-time RL over memory)
items.innovation: RL over memory boosts agents' test-time learning
items.analysis: Innovation: 把 RL 施加在外部记忆(memory)之上,让 agent 在测试期内于任务/episode 中持续改进,而不是只在训练期学习——是测试时学习(test-time learning)与 RL 的结合点。Performance: 论文报告增强了 LLM agent 的测试期学习能力(具体数字以论文为准)。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 与 TTRL 同属'把学习推向推理期'的路线;外部记忆的读写是数据结构层面的机制,不依赖训练端算子,若与 NPU 推理栈结合,可在不动训练基建的情况下获得部分自我改进收益——对训练资源受限、推理栈相对成熟的 Ascend 场景是低门槛的补充路径。
items.summary: Enhances LLM agents' test-time learning by doing RL over an external memory — letting an agent improve within a task/episode rather than only at train time.

items.title: Rethinking Agentic RL in LLMs (survey)
items.innovation: Frames agentic RL as a distinct paradigm vs single-turn RLVR
items.analysis: Innovation: 2026 年综述,把 agentic RL 论证为与单轮 RLVR 不同的范式——LLM 从被动应答者转为主动智能体,系统梳理多轮信用分配、工具/环境交互、长程规划与奖励设计四条主线。Performance: 综述类工作,价值在于领域地图与问题框架而非数字结论。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 与 2025-09 的 Landscape 综述互为补充,可用于校准本看板 agentic RL 卡片的分类框架;其强调的多轮长程 rollout 正是 64GB 910B 显存与 sleep-mode 缺失下压力最大的负载形态,为 NPU 上优先移植哪类 agentic RL 能力(信用分配、异步 rollout、工具环境)提供选型参照。
items.summary: A 2026 survey arguing agentic RL turns LLMs from passive responders into proactive agents — covering multi-turn credit assignment, tool/environment interaction, long-horizon planning, and reward design. A useful map of the agentic-RL landscape.

items.title: ProRL Agent (Rollout-as-a-Service)
items.innovation: Serves the full multi-turn agent rollout lifecycle as an API
items.analysis: Innovation: 把多轮 agent rollout 的完整生命周期(工具调用、环境步进、轨迹管理)封装为服务化 API——'Rollout-as-a-Service',训练器与 rollout 编排彻底解耦,直击 agentic RL 中 rollout 编排成为系统瓶颈的问题。Performance: 微软研究院系统工作,收益主要体现在可扩展性与训练器解耦(具体数字以论文为准)。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 与 AReaL 2.0 的微服务化同向,印证'rollout 独立成服务'正在成为 agentic RL 基建共识;对 Ascend 而言,服务化边界意味着 rollout 可放在 vLLM-Ascend 推理池、训练留在 MindSpeed/verl 侧,天然契合训推分离路线,绕开 sleep-mode 缺失的 colocate 限制。
items.summary: Scalable infrastructure for RL training of multi-turn LLM agents: exposes agentic rollouts (tool calls, environment steps) as a service so the trainer is decoupled from rollout orchestration — addressing the rollout bottleneck in agentic RL.

items.title: Stable Asynchrony (Variance-Controlled Off-Policy RL)
items.innovation: Tames heavy-tailed importance weights from stale rollouts
items.analysis: Innovation: 针对异步 RL 中陈旧样本导致 GRPO/REINFORCE 重要性权重呈重尾分布、梯度方差爆炸的问题,引入方差控制机制,使高异步度下的 off-policy 更新保持稳定。Performance: 定位为让异步 RL 在高 staleness 区间不牺牲收敛稳定性(论文口径,具体数字以原文为准)。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 与 ESTR、GAC、Staleness–LR 标度律同属 2026 年'让高异步度可用'的稳定器谱系——异步/训推分离是 Ascend 上绕开 sleep-mode 缺失的主路线,而方差控制只动 loss 端统计量、不依赖 CUDA 特性,移植到 MindSpeed-RL/verl-on-Ascend 的成本几乎为零。
items.summary: Async RL decouples rollout from updates for throughput, but stale samples give GRPO/REINFORCE heavy-tailed importance weights and high variance. This work adds variance control to keep off-policy/async RL stable at high asynchrony.

items.title: RollMux (Disaggregated RL Post-Training)
items.innovation: Phase-level multiplexing to remove pipeline bubbles
items.analysis: Innovation: 面向训推分离(disaggregated)RL 后训练的系统工作,在 AReaL/StreamRL/AsyncFlow 的解耦路线上更进一步——把 rollout 与训练两个阶段在分离的资源池间做 phase 级复用(multiplexing),消除阶段依赖造成的流水线气泡,同时对样本陈旧度加以约束。Performance: 定位为在不放大 staleness 的前提下提高分离式 RL 的整体资源利用率(具体数字以论文为准)。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 训推分离是 Ascend 上绕开 sleep-mode 缺失的主路线,但分离带来的互等气泡正是吞吐损失所在;phase 级复用思路与 AsyncFlow 的流式异步互补,是 NPU 集群上 rollout/train 资源池调度设计的直接参考。
items.summary: Builds on AReaL/StreamRL/AsyncFlow: multiplexes rollout and training phases across disaggregated resources to remove dependency bubbles while bounding sample staleness — directly relevant to NPU RL throughput.

items.title: GDRO-RL (Group Distributionally Robust Optimization)
items.innovation: Makes GRPO robust to prompt/rollout distribution shift
items.analysis: Innovation: 把组级分布鲁棒优化(GDRO)引入 GRPO——Rollout-GDRO 与 Prompt-GDRO 按最坏情况的 prompt/rollout 分布对组重加权,使训练不被数据异质或不均衡带偏。Performance: 论文报告在异质/失衡训练数据下推理鲁棒性提升(具体数字以论文为准)。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: NPU 上 RL 的数据配比往往受限于可跑的任务与规模,分布失衡更常见;GDRO 只改组级加权逻辑、不新增前向开销与显存负担,是低成本的稳健性增强,可与 Train Less Learn More 的自适应采样在数据端组合使用,对 Ascend 上小规模、数据受限的 RLVR 实验尤其友好。
items.summary: Introduces Rollout-GDRO and Prompt-GDRO, which reweight groups toward the worst-case prompt/rollout distribution on top of GRPO, improving reasoning robustness when training data is heterogeneous or imbalanced.

items.title: G2RL (Gradient-Guided RL)
items.innovation: Lets the model guide its own exploration via gradient signals
items.summary: Uses gradient-guided exploration to steer GRPO-style sampling toward informative trajectories, improving sample efficiency on reasoning RL without a separate critic.

items.title: Critique-GRPO
items.innovation: Adds natural-language critiques on top of numerical reward
items.summary: An online RL framework that combines natural-language feedback with numerical rewards for policy optimization, reporting ~+15–22% Pass@1 gains over GRPO on Qwen models (revised Feb 2026).

items.title: InstructGPT / PPO-RLHF
items.innovation: Canonical 3-stage RLHF: SFT → reward model → PPO
items.summary: Established the standard RLHF recipe where a reward model trained on human preferences supplies the PPO signal, with a KL penalty to the SFT reference. A 1.3B InstructGPT was preferred over 175B GPT-3, making PPO the default RLHF optimizer.

items.title: GRPO (DeepSeekMath)
items.innovation: Drops the critic; advantages from group-normalized rewards
items.analysis: Innovation: removes PPO's value network — for each prompt it samples a group of responses and standardizes their rewards within the group to get advantages, eliminating the critic's memory and tuning burden. Performance: became the default backbone for reasoning RL (DeepSeek-V3/R1 and most 2025 RLVR work) precisely because it's stable and cheap at scale. Fit for RL-on-NPU: critic-free means less memory and fewer moving parts — ideal for memory-constrained 910B, and it's the algorithm MindSpeed-RL and verl-on-Ascend target first, so it's the natural baseline for any Ascend RL benchmark.
items.summary: For each prompt GRPO samples a group of responses and uses the within-group mean/std to compute relative advantages, eliminating PPO's value network and its memory cost. It is the backbone of DeepSeek-V3/R1 and the most widely adopted base for reasoning RL.

items.title: RLVR (Tülu 3)
items.innovation: Replaces the reward model with a deterministic verifier
items.analysis: Innovation: 把 RLHF 目标函数施加到可自动判定对错的任务上——数学、指令约束等输出经确定性验证器检查,验证通过得 1、否则 0,以规则验证器取代 reward model,在 Tülu 3 流水线中被提出并命名。Performance: 免除了 reward model 的训练与部署成本,也从源头规避了 RM 被 hack 的风险,成为其后绝大多数 reasoning RL 工作的共同起点。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 奖励端只是规则判定、无需额外模型前向,显存与算子负担极小,天然适合 64GB 910B 等内存受限环境;作为 2025-26 RLVR 浪潮的源头范式,它也是 Ascend 上 GRPO/R1-Zero 类复现的默认奖励形态,是任何 NPU RL 基准绕不开的基础配方。
items.summary: RL with Verifiable Rewards applies the RLHF objective to checkable tasks (math, instruction constraints), giving reward 1 for verified-correct outputs and 0 otherwise. Introduced/named in the Tülu 3 pipeline, it underpins most subsequent reasoning-RL work.

items.title: RLOO (REINFORCE Leave-One-Out)
items.innovation: Leave-one-out baseline; unbiased, low-variance, no critic
items.analysis: Innovation: 对同一 prompt 采样多条补全,每条的 baseline 取同组其余样本的平均奖励(leave-one-out),得到无偏、低方差且无需 critic 的多样本 REINFORCE 估计器,把 RLHF 的策略优化简化到最朴素的形态。Performance: 在 6.9B 规模上比调优后的 PPO 约快 3 倍、省约 70% 显存,证明去 critic 化在效果与成本上双赢。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 显存是 64GB 910B 上 RL 的首要约束,RLOO 免去 value 网络整份模型的显存,是与 GRPO 同谱系的轻量候选;其组内基线结构与 GRPO 一致,便于在 MindSpeed-RL/verl-on-Ascend 已有的组采样管线上低成本切换对照,适合作为 NPU 上算法端消融实验的基线之一。
items.summary: Each completion's baseline is the average reward of the other samples for the same prompt, giving a simple multi-sample REINFORCE estimator. Trains ~3x faster with ~70% less memory than tuned PPO at 6.9B scale.

items.title: ReMax
items.innovation: Greedy-decoding baseline REINFORCE for RLHF
items.summary: Exploits RLHF's deterministic transitions and trajectory-level rewards with a greedy-decode baseline for variance reduction, dropping PPO's critic and 4+ hyperparameters. Cuts GPU memory ~46% on a 7B model while staying stable.

items.title: DPO (Direct Preference Optimization)
items.innovation: Preferences as a simple classification loss — no RM, no RL sampling
items.summary: Reparameterizes the RLHF reward in terms of the policy itself, reducing alignment to a logistic loss on preference pairs against a frozen reference. Matches or beats PPO-RLHF on sentiment, summarization, and dialogue while being far simpler.
items.analysis: Innovation: reparameterizes the RLHF reward in terms of the policy itself, collapsing alignment into one logistic loss on preference pairs against a frozen reference — no reward model, no sampling, no RL loop. Performance: matches or beats PPO-RLHF on summarization/dialogue/sentiment while being far simpler and more stable. Fit for RL-on-NPU: with no online rollouts it sidesteps the biggest NPU pain point (the missing vLLM sleep-mode) entirely — the easiest alignment method to stand up first on Ascend.

items.title: IPO (Identity Preference Optimization)
items.innovation: ΨPO theory; squared-loss objective robust to deterministic prefs
items.summary: Generalizes RLHF/DPO into a ΨPO objective; with Ψ=identity it avoids the Bradley-Terry assumption and DPO's overfitting on near-deterministic preferences. Provides a unified theory of preference learning.

items.title: KTO (Kahneman-Tversky Optimization)
items.innovation: Aligns from unpaired thumbs-up/down via prospect theory
items.summary: Maximizes a loss-averse human-utility function instead of preference log-likelihood, needing only a binary desirable/undesirable label per example. Practical for imbalanced or unpaired feedback while matching or exceeding DPO.

items.title: ORPO
items.innovation: Odds-ratio penalty folds alignment into SFT — no reference model
items.summary: Appends a log odds-ratio term to the NLL loss during SFT, removing the separate preference phase and reference model. Trained on UltraFeedback alone it surpasses larger Llama-2-Chat/Zephyr on AlpacaEval 2.0 and MT-Bench.

items.title: SimPO
items.innovation: Length-normalized average log-prob as a reference-free reward
items.summary: Aligns the implicit reward with the generation metric and adds a target reward margin, eliminating the reference model. Outperforms DPO and variants across Mistral, Llama 3, and Gemma 2 (NeurIPS 2024).

items.title: DAPO
items.innovation: GRPO + Clip-Higher, dynamic sampling, token-level loss, overlong shaping
items.summary: Targets entropy collapse and length/exploration issues in GRPO and ships as a fully open RL system. On Qwen2.5-32B it reaches 50 on AIME 2024, beating DeepSeek-R1-Zero-Qwen-32B with ~50% fewer steps.
items.analysis: Innovation: a fully open GRPO recipe fixing practical instabilities — Clip-Higher (decoupled clip bounds), dynamic sampling (drop all-correct/all-wrong groups), token-level loss, and overlong-reward shaping. Performance: 50 on AIME-2024 with Qwen2.5-32B at ~half the steps of prior baselines, with data + code released. Fit for RL-on-NPU: its tricks target the noisy-gradient and length-bias problems that worsen under NPU numeric drift, so it's a strong, well-documented baseline to port.

items.title: Dr. GRPO
items.innovation: Removes GRPO length & std-norm biases that inflate response length
items.analysis: Innovation: 诊断出 GRPO 目标函数中的优化偏差——长度归一与组内 std 归一会系统性奖励更长而非更好的响应,导致响应长度膨胀;去掉这两处偏置即得 Dr. GRPO,一个更 token 高效的修正版优化器。Performance: 配合极简 R1-Zero 配方,7B base 模型在 AIME 2024 达到 43.3%,以更短输出取得同等或更好的推理性能。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 响应长度直接决定 rollout 的 KV cache 占用与解码墙钟,而 rollout 正是 NPU RL 显存与时间的大头——抑制无谓的长度膨胀等于直接节省 NPU 上最贵的资源;该修正只改 loss 端归一化项、不涉及任何 CUDA 特性,在 Ascend RL 栈上移植成本几乎为零,适合作为 NPU GRPO 基线的默认修正项。
items.summary: Diagnoses an optimization bias in GRPO that rewards longer (not better) responses and fixes it for a more token-efficient optimizer. A minimalist R1-Zero recipe with the fix hits 43.3% on AIME 2024 with a 7B base.

items.title: VAPO
items.innovation: Value-based PPO for long-CoT with length-adaptive GAE
items.analysis: Innovation: 在 GRPO 系去 critic 化浪潮中反向重申价值函数路线——面向长 CoT 的 value-based PPO,整合 DAPO/VC-PPO 的工程技巧,引入 Length-Adaptive GAE 与 Decoupled GAE 处理长序列优势估计,辅以正例 LM loss。Performance: Qwen2.5-32B 上约 5,000 步达到 AIME 2024 60.4 的 SOTA,说明长推理场景下精心设计的 critic 仍有信息增益。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: critic 意味着额外一份模型的显存与前向开销,在 64GB 910B 上代价比 GPU 侧更沉重——VAPO 提示的取舍是「步数效率 vs 单步成本」:若其步数优势成立,总算力受限的 NPU 集群反而可能整体受益;但落地前需先确认 critic 训练在 NPU 数值漂移环境下的稳定性,适合作为 GRPO 系之外的对照路线纳入 Ascend RL 基准。
items.summary: Reasserts the critic paradigm for long reasoning, combining DAPO/VC-PPO tricks with Length-Adaptive and Decoupled GAE plus positive-example LM loss. Scores SOTA 60.4 on AIME 2024 on Qwen2.5-32B in ~5,000 steps.

items.title: GSPO (Group Sequence Policy Optimization)
items.innovation: Sequence-level importance ratios & clipping — stabilizes MoE RL
items.analysis: Innovation: 把 GRPO 的失稳归因于 token 级重要性权重的误用——其方差随序列长度增长,据此改为序列级重要性比率与序列级 clip,整条响应作为优化单元。Performance: Qwen 团队报告显著更稳,尤其缓解 MoE RL 的崩溃问题,并用于 Qwen3 的后训练。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: MoE RL 的训推失配(路由漂移)在 NPU 上会叠加算子数值差异而放大,序列级比率天然对 token 级扰动更不敏感,是 Ascend 上跑 MoE RL 的首选 loss 形态之一;与 R3 类路由回放机制互补——一个在算法端钝化敏感度,一个在系统端消除失配源,两者都只涉及可移植的算法/记录层改动。
items.summary: Attributes GRPO's instability to mis-applied token-level importance weights whose variance grows with length. Sequence-level optimization is more stable, notably for MoE RL, and contributed to Qwen3.

items.title: CISPO (MiniMax-M1)
items.innovation: Clips IS-weights, not token updates — keeps pivotal low-prob tokens
items.analysis: Innovation: 与 PPO/GRPO 裁剪 token 更新不同,CISPO 只裁剪重要性采样权重本身、保留所有 token 的梯度贡献,使 'Wait/Aha' 等低概率但关键的反思 token 不会被 clip 掉而失去更新。Performance: 报告较 DAPO 约 2 倍提速,支撑 MiniMax-M1 在 512 张 H800 上约三周完成完整 RL 训练。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 已被 AReaL 2.0 收录为内建 loss,说明其工程通用性;对 off-policy 偏差更宽容的权重裁剪也降低了对训推严格一致的依赖,在存在数值漂移的 Ascend 栈上是比标准 clip 更稳妥的候选目标函数,且移植只涉及 loss 端改动、成本极低。
items.summary: Bounds variance via importance-sampling-weight clipping while keeping every token's gradient contribution, so 'reflection' tokens (Wait, Aha) still update. ~2x speedup over DAPO; enabled M1's full RL run on 512 H800s in ~3 weeks.

items.title: ProRL
items.innovation: Prolonged RL uncovers genuinely new reasoning strategies
items.analysis: Innovation: 主张延长 RL 训练(prolonged RL)能让模型发现 base 模型中原本不存在的新推理策略,而非仅放大既有行为;技术上以 KL 控制、参考策略定期重置与多样化任务套件稳定超长 RL 运行。Performance: 产出 Nemotron-Research-Reasoning-Qwen-1.5B,为「RL 能扩展推理边界」提供了正面证据,与 1-shot RLVR/Spurious Rewards 的「RL 只是激发潜能」一派形成关键对照。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 超长 RL 运行会放大一切系统性问题——数值漂移随步数累积、集群稳定性与故障恢复被反复考验,恰是 Ascend 栈的薄弱环节;其 KL 控制与参考策略重置属纯算法层稳定器、可直接移植,为 NPU 上的长周期 RL 实验提供了现成的稳定性配方。
items.summary: Stabilizes very long RL runs via KL control, reference-policy resetting, and a diverse task suite, showing prolonged RL expands reasoning boundaries rather than just amplifying base behaviors. Produced Nemotron-Research-Reasoning-Qwen-1.5B.

items.title: DeepSeek-R1 / R1-Zero
items.innovation: Reasoning emerges from pure RL (GRPO) with no SFT (R1-Zero)
items.summary: R1-Zero is trained by RL only and self-evolves chain-of-thought, reflection, and verification; R1 adds cold-start + multi-stage RL to reach o1-level (AIME 2024 pass@1 79.8%). The main reason GRPO+verifiable-reward RL became the 2025 paradigm.
items.analysis: Innovation: showed that large-scale RL with verifiable rewards (GRPO) alone — no SFT cold-start in R1-Zero — can elicit emergent long chain-of-thought, self-verification, and reflection. Performance: R1 reached o1-level math/code reasoning and, crucially, shipped open-weight, catalyzing the entire 2025 RLVR wave. Fit for RL-on-NPU: R1-Zero recipes are the canonical thing people reproduce on Ascend (small scale and 671B-MoE via MindSpeed-RL), making it the reference workload for any RL-on-NPU benchmark.

items.title: OpenAI o1
items.innovation: Large-scale RL teaches a long internal chain-of-thought
items.summary: Trained with large-scale RL to think productively before answering — decomposing, self-correcting, exploring alternatives. Performance scales with both more RL training and more test-time thinking.

items.title: OpenAI o3 / o4-mini
items.innovation: Scaled RL reasoning + agentic tool use inside the chain-of-thought
items.summary: o3 is OpenAI's most capable reasoner (~88% ARC-AGI, 96.7% AIME 2024); o4-mini is cheaper/faster. First o-series models trained to fully use tools (web, Python, vision) agentically within reasoning.

items.title: QwQ-32B
items.innovation: 32B dense rivals 671B R1 via scaled RL with rule-based verifiers
items.analysis: Innovation: 用规则验证器驱动的 scaled RL 从冷启动 checkpoint 出发,先在数学/代码上以 outcome verifier 训练、再接通用阶段,使 32B dense 模型达到 671B 级 DeepSeek-R1 的推理水平,并以 Apache 2.0 开源。Performance: 以远小的参数规模对齐 R1 级推理,是「中等规模 dense + 充分 RL」路线最有说服力的实证之一。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 32B dense 是 910B 集群上现实可负担的 RL 目标规模——无 MoE 路由的训推一致难题,dense 结构对算子覆盖的要求也最低;Qwen 家族在 vLLM-Ascend 支持最全(本卡标注 ascend ready),QwQ 的分阶段 verifier RL 配方因此是 Ascend 上复现前沿推理 RL 性价比最高的参照物之一。
items.summary: Applies scaled RL from a cold-start checkpoint, first on math/coding with outcome verifiers then a general stage. Matches DeepSeek-R1-class reasoning at 32B, released Apache 2.0.

items.title: Qwen3
items.innovation: Unified thinking/non-thinking modes with a tunable thinking budget
items.analysis: Innovation: 在同一模型内统一 thinking/non-thinking 两种模式并提供可调 thinking budget,由四阶段后训练流水线(长 CoT SFT → 推理 RL → 模式融合 → 通用 RL)实现;家族覆盖 0.6B–235B 的 dense 与 MoE。Performance: 技术报告特别指出,对小模型而言 strong-to-weak 蒸馏能以约 1/10 成本超过直接 RL——这对后训练预算分配是重要的实证信号。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 本卡标注 ascend ready(vLLM-Ascend 支持、W8A8),Qwen3 系是 NPU 上 RL 底座的默认候选谱系;其「小模型蒸馏优于 RL」的结论对算力受限的 Ascend 场景尤其有操作意义——小规模先蒸馏、把 RL 预算留给收益更高的中大规模;四阶段流水线也为 NPU 上组织后训练阶段提供了可直接套用的模板。
items.summary: Dense + MoE (0.6B–235B) integrate reasoning and fast modes in one model via a four-stage post-training pipeline (long-CoT SFT + RL + fusion + general RL). Notes strong-to-weak distillation beating RL at ~1/10 cost for small models.

items.title: Kimi k1.5
items.innovation: Simplified RL scaling context length; no MCTS/value/PRM
items.summary: Multimodal model trained with a streamlined online-mirror-descent RL recipe that treats context length as a key lever. Matches o1 (77.5 AIME, 96.2 MATH-500) and adds long2short transfer to short-CoT models.
items.ascendNote: API model — no public Ascend port.

items.title: MiniMax-M1
items.innovation: Open hybrid (lightning-attention + MoE) reasoner trained with CISPO
items.analysis: Innovation: 开源混合架构推理模型——lightning attention(线性注意力)与 MoE 结合,456B 总参/45.9B 激活、原生 1M 上下文,RL 端配套 CISPO(裁剪 IS 权重而非 token 更新)。Performance: 100K token 生成时长 CoT 的 FLOPs 约为 R1 的 25%;完整 RL 在 512 张 H800 上约三周(约 53.5 万美元)完成,是前沿规模 RL 成本最透明的公开数据点之一。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 线性注意力把 decode 成本从二次降为近线性,而 rollout 恰是 decode 密集负载——这类架构在带宽紧缺的 NPU 上理论收益更大;本卡标注 ascend partial(MiniMax 家族在 vLLM-Ascend 有 W8A8/QuaRot),lightning attention 算子在 Ascend 侧的覆盖情况是能否承接的关键,其公开的 RL 成本账目与 CISPO 配方对 NPU RL 预算规划亦有直接参考价值。
items.summary: 456B total / 45.9B active, native 1M-token context; lightning attention makes long-CoT ~25% of R1's FLOPs at 100K tokens. Full RL on 512 H800s in three weeks (~$535K).
items.ascendNote: MiniMax family has W8A8/QuaRot on vLLM-Ascend (M2.x).

items.title: Llama-Nemotron
items.innovation: Open reasoning family with a dynamic reasoning on/off toggle
items.summary: Nano/Super/Ultra built via NAS + distillation then SFT and large-scale RL. LN-Ultra beats DeepSeek-R1 while fitting on a single 8xH100 node; models, data, and code released.

items.title: Phi-4-reasoning(-plus)
items.innovation: Small-model reasoning from curated SFT + short outcome-based RL
items.summary: 14B model SFT'd on 'teachable' prompts with o3-mini traces; the -plus variant adds a brief outcome-based RL stage that lengthens reasoning traces. Rivals DeepSeek-R1-class performance while far smaller.

items.title: Magistral
items.innovation: Ground-up async RL stack; strong reasoning from RL on text alone
items.analysis: Innovation: Mistral 从零自建异步 RL 训练栈,Magistral Medium 仅用 RL(GRPO 基)从 Mistral Medium 3 训出、不依赖任何推理模型蒸馏,证明纯文本 RL 即可获得强推理;Small 版加冷启动蒸馏并以 Apache 2.0 开源。Performance: 其论文价值在于罕见地详细公开了工业级可扩展异步 RLVR 基建的设计细节,是同类系统论述中信息密度最高的之一。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 异步/训推分离是 Ascend 绕开 sleep-mode 缺失的主路线,Magistral 提供了「从零搭异步 RL 栈」的完整工业蓝图——权重同步、rollout 编排、staleness 处理等设计决策可直接对照到 NPU 场景;其「RL-only 不蒸馏」的结果也为 NPU 上无强教师模型可用时的后训练路线提供了信心。
items.summary: Magistral Medium trained by RL only (GRPO-based) on Mistral Medium 3; Small adds cold-start distillation (Apache 2.0). A rare detailed industrial account of scalable async RLVR infrastructure.

items.title: Seed1.5-Thinking
items.innovation: RL with a verifiable/general/hybrid triple data engine + stabilizers
items.summary: Compact MoE (20B active / 200B total) reaching 86.7 AIME 2024 and 77.3 GPQA, using value pretraining, decoupled GAE, and online data adaptation. Generalizes well beyond reasoning.

items.title: GLM-4.5
items.innovation: Hybrid reasoning MoE; ARC (agentic/reasoning/coding) post-training
items.analysis: Innovation: 355B 总参/32B 激活的混合推理 MoE,单模型内置 thinking 与 direct 两种模式,后训练围绕 ARC(agentic/reasoning/coding)三能力组织——以专家模型迭代加 RL 的方式做能力融合,23T token 训练。Performance: 自报 AIME 2024 91.0%、SWE-bench Verified 64.2%;RLCS 训练法并延伸到 GLM-V 多模态,开源权重使其成为 agentic 后训练研究的重要底座。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 本卡标注 ascend partial——GLM 家族在 vLLM-Ascend 有支持(GLM-5 W8A8C8),4.5 属较旧世代;其意义更多在配方侧:ARC 三线并进的后训练组织方式与专家迭代融合路线,是 Ascend 上规划多能力 RL 后训练时可借鉴的结构模板,32B 激活规模也在 910B 集群可承受的范围内。
items.summary: 355B total / 32B active MoE with thinking and direct modes, trained on 23T tokens with expert-model iteration + RL; 91.0% AIME 2024, 64.2% SWE-bench Verified. RLCS extends to multimodal in GLM-V.
items.ascendNote: GLM family on vLLM-Ascend (GLM-5 W8A8C8); 4.5 is older.

items.title: Grok 3 (Think)
items.innovation: Reasoning refined via large-scale RL on the Colossus cluster
items.summary: Uses large-scale RL to think for seconds to minutes, backtracking and exploring alternatives via 'Think' mode, integrated with DeepSearch. Reports 93.3% AIME 2025, 84.6% GPQA.

items.title: verl (HybridFlow)
items.innovation: Hybrid-controller dataflow; first-class Ascend NPU support
items.summary: Supports PPO/GRPO/GSPO/DAPO/RLOO/PRIME and VLM RL with FSDP/Megatron training + vLLM/SGLang rollout, scaling to 671B. The only major framework with confirmed NVIDIA + AMD ROCm + Ascend support.
items.analysis: Innovation: a hybrid-controller dataflow separating single-controller RL orchestration from multi-controller distributed compute, making PPO/GRPO/RLOO pipelines composable — and it ships first-class Ascend NPU support. Performance: among the most widely adopted open RL frameworks, with strong throughput via colocated train/rollout. Fit for RL-on-NPU: this is the primary stack RL-on-Ascend work targets; its vLLM-Ascend rollout path is the realistic way to run GRPO on 910B today.

items.title: OpenRLHF
items.innovation: First Ray + vLLM RLHF framework; async agentic RL
items.analysis: Innovation: 首个把 Ray + vLLM 组合成分布式 RLHF 方案的开源框架——Actor/Critic/Reward/Reference 四类模型经 Ray 分布到不同 GPU、DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 承载训练、vLLM 加速生成,支持 PPO/GRPO/REINFORCE++/DAPO 至 70B+ 规模,并扩展到异步 agentic RL。Performance: 作为早期确立「Ray 编排 + vLLM rollout」范式的框架,其架构被后续多个主流 RL 框架继承。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 本卡明确其 Ascend 支持状态为 WIP——相比 verl(已验证)与 ROLL(有第一方文档),OpenRLHF 是主流 RL 框架中 NPU 故事最不完整的一个,适配进度值得持续跟踪;其多模型分离部署的结构与 NPU 上训推分离的现实约束天然契合,一旦 vLLM-Ascend 后端接通,迁移路径相对清晰。
items.summary: Distributes Actor/Critic/Reward/Reference across GPUs on DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 + Ray + vLLM, supporting PPO/GRPO/REINFORCE++/DAPO at 70B+ scale. Ascend support is WIP.

items.title: TRL
items.innovation: Tight Transformers/PEFT integration; simple GRPO/DPO trainers
items.summary: GRPOTrainer/DPOTrainer/PPOTrainer/RewardTrainer scale via Accelerate (DDP/DeepSpeed/FSDP). The easiest on-ramp for RL fine-tuning in the HF ecosystem.

items.title: NeMo-RL / NeMo-Aligner
items.innovation: Megatron-Core + Ray post-training to thousands of GPUs / 100B+
items.summary: Supports GRPO/DAPO/PPO/DPO/RM and on-policy distillation with Megatron parallelism and Ray orchestration. Influenced verl, SkyRL, and ROLL.

items.title: AReaL
items.innovation: Fully asynchronous RL: decouples generation from training (~2.77x)
items.summary: Rollout workers generate continuously while trainers update asynchronously with staleness-enhanced PPO. AReaL-lite offers an algorithm-first async API; uses SGLang for rollout.
items.analysis: Innovation: a fully asynchronous RL system that decouples generation from training so rollout workers never block on the trainer, attacking the idle/bubble problem of synchronous colocated RL. Performance: large throughput gains over synchronous baselines, at the cost of off-policy staleness that needs correction. Fit for RL-on-NPU: async decoupling is especially valuable on Ascend, where the missing vLLM sleep-mode makes colocated rollout/train memory-contended; AReaL has a dedicated Ascend branch.

items.title: slime
items.innovation: Thin Megatron↔SGLang glue — the RL stack behind GLM-4.5/4.6
items.analysis: Innovation: 以最薄的抽象把 Megatron 训练直连 SGLang rollout,外加 Data Buffer 数据缓冲模块——刻意反'大而全框架'的极简设计,是 GLM-4.5/4.6 背后经生产验证的 RL 栈。Performance: 支撑 GLM 系 SOTA 发布;后续 v0.3.1 又把训推一致(top-p masking、R3 路由专家)做进框架(见对应卡片)。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 薄胶水意味着可替换面小——把 SGLang 换成 SGLang-on-Ascend、Megatron 侧换成 MindSpeed 的适配面比重型框架小得多;其 Data Buffer 与训推直连的结构也是在 NPU 上搭建最小可用 RL 流水线的合理蓝本,值得作为移植候选评估。
items.summary: Wires Megatron training directly to SGLang rollout with minimal abstraction plus a Data Buffer module, validated on SOTA GLM releases.

items.title: ROLL
items.innovation: Multi-role Ray architecture for RLHF/RLVR/agentic
items.summary: Flexible resource allocation across roles integrating Megatron-Core, vLLM and SGLang for preference, RLVR, and multi-turn agentic RL. Ascend support is an open RFC.

items.title: SkyRL
items.innovation: Modular full-stack RL for multi-turn, long-horizon agents
items.summary: skyrl-train / -gym / -agent / -tx with async dispatching and backend interop (verl, Tinker); skyrl-tx aims at cross-platform backends.

items.title: PRIME
items.innovation: Implicit process rewards — dense per-token rewards, no process labels
items.summary: Online RL with process rewards from an ORM-trained PRM and no separate value model; integrated as an algorithm in verl.

items.title: prime-rl (Prime Intellect)
items.innovation: Decentralized, fully async off-policy RL (INTELLECT-2/3)
items.summary: Globally distributed async RL using FSDP2 + vLLM with FP8, PD disaggregation and EP/CP parallelism, plus TOPLOC rollout verification and SHARDCAST weight broadcast. Designed for 1000+ GPUs.

items.title: open-instruct
items.innovation: Introduced RLVR; trained Tülu 3 / OLMo 2
items.summary: SFT, DPO, PPO and GRPO-based RLVR scalable with Ray + vLLM. The reference implementation of verifiable-reward RL.

items.title: Unsloth (RL)
items.innovation: GRPO on a single small GPU (~5GB) via custom Triton kernels
items.summary: Memory-efficient GRPO with LoRA/QLoRA, vLLM-backed generation, long-context RL and FP8, optimized for single-GPU/local use.

items.title: Axolotl (RL)
items.innovation: Config-driven GRPO on TRL with async generation + replay
items.summary: GRPO/GDPO plus DPO with vLLM serving, importance-sampling correction, replay buffers, FSDP and DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 multi-GPU scaling.

items.title: Let's Verify Step by Step (PRM800K)
items.innovation: Step-level process supervision beats outcome supervision
items.summary: Trains a process reward model on per-step human feedback, solving 78% of a MATH subset and outperforming outcome-only RMs. Released the 800K-label PRM800K dataset anchoring modern process supervision.

items.title: Qwen2.5-Math-PRM
items.innovation: MC estimation + LLM-as-judge consensus filtering for PRMs
items.summary: Shows naive MC step labeling is noisy and BoN eval is misled by correct-answer/flawed-process cases, then fixes it with consensus filtering. Releases strong open PRM-7B/72B baselines.

items.title: Scaling Test-Time Compute
items.innovation: Compute-optimal inference can beat a ~14x larger model
items.summary: Analyzes how to spend a fixed inference budget across verifier-guided search and sequential revision, finding adaptive strategies beat best-of-N. Provides the scaling rationale behind long-CoT and verifier-driven RL.

items.title: ExGRPO
items.innovation: Prioritized experience replay for RLVR (off-policy)
items.analysis: Innovation: 把优先经验回放引入 RLVR——按正确率/熵把历史轨迹分桶,识别高价值经验并以混合 on/off-policy 目标复用,而非每步全量新采样。Performance: 报告较 on-policy RLVR 提升 +3.5/+7.6 分,并能稳定原本会崩溃的训练。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 与 PNPO 的多 epoch 复用、Train Less Learn More 的自适应采样同属'少生成、多利用'路线——rollout 是 NPU RL 墙钟与显存的大头,经验回放直接摊薄生成成本;回放缓冲属纯数据管理层机制,不触碰算子与并行策略,是 Ascend 上性价比最高的效率手段之一,也便于与异步架构的样本池自然结合。
items.summary: Buckets past trajectories by correctness/entropy and reuses high-value ones with a mixed on/off-policy objective. +3.5/+7.6 point gains over on-policy RLVR and stabilizes runs that otherwise collapse.

items.title: Search-R1
items.innovation: RL teaches interleaved multi-turn search within reasoning
items.analysis: Innovation: 用 RL 教会模型在推理过程中自主交错发起多轮搜索查询——关键工程手段是把检索回来的 token 从 loss 中 mask 掉,只对模型自生成 token 计算策略梯度,从而稳定训练;检索时机与查询内容由任务奖励端到端塑造。Performance: Qwen2.5-7B 上较强 RAG 基线的 QA 准确率提升 41%,确立了「搜索行为可由 RL 习得」的范式。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 检索 token 掩码是 agentic RL 中处理工具返回内容的通用配方,属 loss 端数据处理、与硬件无关,可直接用于 Ascend 上的工具增强 RL;多轮搜索使 rollout 链路引入外部 IO 等待,天然契合异步 rollout 架构——这与 NPU 上绕开 sleep-mode 的训推分离路线同构,是 NPU agentic RL 合理的起步负载。
items.summary: The model autonomously issues search queries during reasoning, trained stably by masking retrieved tokens from the loss. +41% QA accuracy (Qwen2.5-7B) over strong RAG baselines.

items.title: ReTool
items.innovation: Outcome-driven RL for strategic code-interpreter use
items.summary: Cold-starts on code-augmented traces then RL refines tool-invocation strategy with emergent code self-correction. Reaches 67.0% AIME 2024 (Qwen2.5-32B) in only 400 steps.

items.title: RAGEN / StarPO
items.innovation: Trajectory-level multi-turn agent RL; 'Echo Trap' stabilization
items.summary: StarPO trains agents across stochastic environments; StarPO-S counters reward-variance cliffs and gradient spikes via trajectory filtering and critic baselining. A systematic recipe for self-evolving agents.

items.title: Self-Rewarding Language Models
items.innovation: Model generates its own rewards via LLM-as-judge during iterative DPO
items.summary: The policy judges its own outputs to build preference pairs, so instruction-following and self-judging improve together. Iterated self-rewarding can surpass models trained on human preference data.

items.title: Spurious Rewards
items.innovation: Random/wrong rewards still boost RLVR on Qwen — but model-specific
items.summary: Random, format, or wrong-label rewards lift Qwen2.5-Math MATH-500 by 21–26 points (vs 29.1 for true rewards) by amplifying latent code reasoning, yet fail on Llama/OLMo. A caution that RLVR 'gains' may elicit pre-existing behaviors.

items.title: 1-shot RLVR
items.innovation: A single training example nearly matches thousands via RLVR
items.analysis: Innovation: 证明单个训练样例的 RLVR 即可几乎追平数千样例——Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 在 MATH500 上从 36.0% 升至 73.6%,且收益跨域泛化;分析显示效果主要由 policy-gradient loss 驱动。Performance: 与 Spurious Rewards 互为印证,构成「RLVR 主要在激发 base 模型潜能而非注入新能力」的最强证据链,直接动摇了「RL 数据越多越好」的默认假设。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 对算力受限的 Ascend 场景是重大利好——若极少样例即可兑现大部分 RLVR 收益,NPU 上的小规模 RL 实验(TRL-on-910B 级别)就足以验证配方,不必先建大集群;它也提示 NPU RL 基准设计应报告数据效率维度,并警惕把「激发潜能」误读为配方本身的能力增益。
items.summary: One example raises Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B MATH500 from 36.0% to 73.6% with cross-domain generalization. Strong evidence that RLVR largely elicits latent capability, driven mainly by the policy-gradient loss.

items.title: Entropy Mechanism of RL
items.innovation: Clip-Cov / KL-Cov prevent policy-entropy collapse
items.analysis: Innovation: 把 RL 训练后期的性能饱和归因于策略熵坍缩,并给出机制解释——熵的变化由动作 log-prob 与优势的协方差驱动;据此提出 Clip-Cov 与 KL-Cov,对高协方差 token 施加裁剪或 KL 惩罚以维持探索。Performance: 成为被广泛引用的熵坍缩修复方案,为「何时该干预熵」提供了可计算的判据,而非笼统的熵正则项。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 熵坍缩是 GRPO 系长跑的共性病,与硬件无关但在 NPU 上更难察觉——数值漂移本身也会扰动熵统计,二者混淆会误导调参;Clip-Cov/KL-Cov 只涉及 loss 端逐 token 统计量,移植到 Ascend 成本极低,且其协方差判据可顺带作为训练健康度指标纳入 NPU RL 监控面板,与 align-probe 类一致性工具形成互补。
items.summary: Links performance saturation to entropy collapse via log-prob/advantage covariance and clips/penalizes high-covariance tokens to sustain exploration. A widely-cited entropy-collapse fix.

items.title: TTRL (Test-Time RL)
items.innovation: Majority-vote pseudo-reward enables RL on unlabeled test data
items.analysis: Innovation: 在无 ground truth 的测试数据上做 RL——对同一问题采样多条回答,以多数投票的自洽共识充当伪奖励,把 RLVR 的验证器替换为模型自身的一致性信号,训练全程无需标注。Performance: 仅用无标注测试数据即把 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 AIME 2024 的 pass@1 提升约 159%,展示了测试期自我提升的上限。对 RL-on-NPU 的意义: 免标注意味着 NPU 上可用任意领域数据直接起 RL 实验、绕开验证器工程;但多数投票要求每题采样大量回答,rollout 开销比标准 RLVR 更重——在 rollout 已是 910B 瓶颈的前提下,TTRL 类方法更依赖量化 rollout、投机解码等生成端加速;且伪奖励完全由模型自身输出分布决定,训推数值漂移会直接污染奖励信号,一致性核查在此类方法上的重要性被进一步放大。
items.summary: Estimates rewards at inference from self-consistency voting, needing no ground truth. Boosts Qwen2.5-Math-7B pass@1 on AIME 2024 by ~159% using only unlabeled test data.

items.title: Reward Shaping vs Reward Hacking
items.innovation: Bounded reward shaping (PAR) resists proxy over-optimization
items.summary: Unifies reward-hacking defenses (robust RM training vs RL regularization) and proposes Preference-As-Reward shaping using the RM's latent signal. Part of the active reward-robustness line alongside ensembles and uncertainty RMs.
